title: Root Causes for Singtel's Recent Outage, Impact of Disruption to Essential Services and Measures to Ensure Telecom Operational Continuity and Resilience
what_it_is: Root Causes for Singtel's Recent Outage, Impact of Disruption to Essential Services and Measures to Ensure Telecom Operational Continuity and Resilience

sections.label: Singtel fixed line disruption
sections.summary: During the disruption about half of calls could still be connected, services were restored over four hours, and a technical issue affected a network component.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: During the disruption, it is estimated that half of the calls could still be connected.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: All services were progressively restored over a four-hour time period from the start of the incident.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Preliminary findings suggest that there was a technical issue which affected the proper functioning of a network component in one of the two systems supporting Singtel's fixed line voice service.

sections.label: IMDA enforcement under Telecommunication Act
sections.summary: IMDA will not hesitate to take strong action under the Telecommunication Act, including financial penalties, if lapses are identified.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: IMDA will not hesitate to take strong action under the Telecommunication Act, including imposing financial penalties, should any lapses be identified.

sections.label: SCDF and SPF emergency hotline review
sections.summary: The public was told to contact SCDF and SPF by SMS, and both are reviewing resiliency measures with IMDA, with no feedback on failed responses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: When the SCDF and SPF learned of the technical difficulties faced by some callers, the public was informed to contact SCDF via SMS 70995 and SPF via SMS 70999.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: The SCDF and SPF are conducting a comprehensive review with IMDA to evaluate additional resiliency measures including the feasibility of telco diversity for our emergency hotlines.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: Just to also add, arising from that incident, there was no feedback from the public on SCDF and SPF's failure to respond to any urgent or life-threatening incident.

sections.label: Awareness plans and requested numbers
sections.summary: The speaker was asked about other plans to raise awareness of these alternatives and said he did not have the specific numbers requested.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazel Poa (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: And are other plans to raise awareness of these alternatives?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I do not have the specific numbers that she requested for as the Parliamentary Question (PQ) was originally directed at the Ministry of Digital Development and Information.
